stories.assessment: Host invoice investigator finishes queued source extraction, validates reviewed records/citations, matches exact amounts and historical policy, and persists one draft proposal or targeted clarification. No autonomous interpretation of unreviewed invoice fields is claimed.

Exact approval gateway executes synthetic ERP drafts and reconciles authoritative state after timeout. Evidence, receipt and final draft are linked to legal run transitions. Revocation/state conflicts persist unresolved reasons; concurrent denial cannot erase verified success.
Result packs preserve per-run evidence, unresolved reasons and currency-separated exact totals. Unknown discrepancy counts remain explicit; only all-verified outcomes are complete.

Durable batch child tasks have stable submission IDs and 1-4 bounded workers, independent failure outcomes, cancellation of unscheduled items, explicit restart recovery and summaries reflecting committed draft outcomes.

Host synthetic connector shares persistent per-connection request/concurrency budgets, per-task admission and bounded numeric/date Retry-After cooldowns. No sleeping retry queue; other connections remain usable.

Host webhook ingress validates signed bytes, bounded timestamps and strict normalized schema; persistent tenant/connection/event identity rejects replay. No externally reachable webhook listener is enabled.

Baseline CLI pins actual Ollama digest, template, quantization and parameters before A/A evaluation. Source mode is immutable; identity failures persist across resume. Real Qwen attempts failed, so comparison/promotion eligibility is false.
OpenTelemetry fixed-name spans correlate Rust/Go/private Python requests and runtime/provider/connector calls. Exported attributes are allowlisted; unsampled parents and malformed IDs are covered.

Prometheus counters/histograms/gauges separate sources and retain failed/cancelled/rejected outcomes, active operations, saturation, queue delay/depth, budget exhaustion and unknown costs. No user/task label cardinality.
Allowlisted timestamped local structured records carry trace/span IDs and outcome/timing. Uvicorn stderr filter removes raw exception messages before formatting. Sentinel checks cover both sinks.
Real Prometheus recording-rule execution verifies exact failure ratios and missing denominators. Rules include latency, queue wait and unknown cost; absence remains missing rather than zero healthy.

Provisioned Grafana panels were rendered against a local synthetic Prometheus server. Queried and rendered provider failure ratio was 0.1 and runtime 0.0. Missing data and unknown cost remain visible; deployment target/credential provisioning is explicit.

Prometheus sustained/missing-data rules and persistent local incident state deduplicate breaches, preserve missing telemetry and emit one recovery transition. No external notification delivery is configured.

Ramp-led Angular Connection diagnostics panel calls explicit authenticated Go command and verifies content SHA-256 before local download. Bounded projection excludes source bodies, prompts and credentials. Rendered/keyboard/axe/retry evidence at 1440x1000 and 800x640.

Admission rejects before body buffering; agent concurrency is bounded. Load test admits 8 of 200 simultaneous slow requests, sheds 192 with no pending queue and recovers. Shared connector throttling is also exercised.

Read-only bounded startup/storage inspection distinguishes incomplete checks from damage and finds missing artifacts. Verified snapshot restore creates a separate read-only workspace and preserves corrupt original bytes. Healthy large/timeout inspections are not mislabeled corruption.

Generated UTF-8/ZIP secret scanning fails on seeded secrets, common credential signatures, unsupported binary/archive input and scanner errors. Diagnostic, training bundle and protected export boundaries scan before output; denied protected exports create no plaintext file.

Installed pnpm graph policy enforces explicit license expressions and high/critical advisories with exact expiring exceptions. Empty/inconsistent summaries and absent advisory detail fail closed. Actual 311-package inventory and advisory report passed. Python/Go/Rust graphs are not certified by this policy.

Host-selected exact run/artifact scope and 32-byte provided key produce AES-256-GCM exports without plaintext files. Holder roundtrip, wrong key, tampering, missing key, denied scope and pre-encryption secret denial are tested.

Rendered CI runs actual Angular/Go/Python stack, accessibility and reviewed geometry/style contracts at two sizes, and retains screenshots plus expected/actual differences. Deliberate overflow fails validation. Browser absence and empty screens cannot pass; no pixel-perfect cross-platform equality is claimed.

publication: No staging, commits or pushes. Internal Markdown stays ignored.
architecture_note: Keep explicit host tools for synthetic finance, repair and scoped export; renderer/model cannot acquire host authority. Use existing gateway, not a new business-write API. Baseline implementation lives in training/baseline.py alongside existing training helpers.
